audience: studio owners and front-desk teams who run classes, workshops and client passes on Zenamu

useCases.title: Check the class schedule for a date range
useCases.text: List the published classes for a date range, with times, lecturers and places. Canceled classes stay in the list and are marked as canceled.

useCases.title: Review the workshops and who teaches them
useCases.text: List the public workshops for a date range, with their own addresses. Then list the lecturers to see who teaches.

useCases.title: Find clients with low entry-pass balances
useCases.text: List the active clients with their credit and entry-pass balances, and their pass balances per pass group. The list holds personal data.

useCases.title: Grant entry passes or credits to a client
useCases.text: Check the client's balance first, because a retry can grant twice. Then add entry passes or credits, and choose whether the client gets an email.
